text: A group of flamingos is called a ____.

A day on Venus is actually longer than its ____.

Dimples were added to golf balls after players noticed that old, roughened-up balls flew ____ than smooth new ones.
Scaled down proportionally, Saturn's rings would be thinner than a sheet of ____.
The tongue of a blue whale can weigh as much as an entire ____.
A group of ferrets is called a ____.
A group of hedgehogs is called a ____.
